papers.title: Turbo Harness: Instance-Adaptive Harness Optimization
papers.abstract: Automating the search for effective harnesses is an important step toward enabling agents to recursively self-improve. Existing harness optimizations typically produce a single global harness that is applied uniformly across task instances. However, a harness that works well on average may not be optimal for every instance. We introduce Turbo Harness, a framework that can adapt a globally optimized harness to each instance by reusing information generated during the original optimization process
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.40330）：Turbo Harness 把 agent harness optimization 从'single global harness uniformly applied'推到'instance-adaptive'——认识到'a harness that works well on average may not be optimal for every instance'。复用优化过程生成的信息（按 instance 调整 harness）为每个 task instance 优化，是 ai-agent × inference-serving 的'per-instance harness self-improvement'工程化资产——把'harness'从全局静态配置变成 instance-level 动态资产；与昨日 35760 TokenCast 'agent cost governance' 同属'agent production 治理'主线（前者 cost、本次 harness），今日 40360 Semifactual RLVR 在'decoding-time robustness' 互补。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 reused-information 形式化、per-instance adaptation cost、benchmark 是否覆盖多 agent framework。今日动作：即时试点方向，写'turbo-harness instance-adaptive' checklist 草稿。

papers.title: Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet their predictions remain sensitive to task-irrelevant prompt features. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.40360）：Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization 用 semifactual prompt interventions（保留 underlying problem 与 answer、只扰 task-irrelevant features）暴露 RLVR 训练 LLM 在 token-level 对 task-irrelevant features 的敏感性，发现 token-level 敏感性差异显著，提出 decoding-time 抑制 high-drift token candidate 提升推理准确度。是 inference-serving × llm-evaluation × context-engineering 的'decoding-time robustness for RLVR-trained LLM'趋势资产——'semifactual sensitivity as RLVR diagnostic'范式可迁移到任何 RLVR 后 LLM；与 40330 Turbo Harness 同属'agent × RL 训练稳定性'主线但路径不同（前者 harness、后者 decoding）；与 40361 Ranking-Aware Prompt Optimization 在'非 accuracy 目标 × 鲁棒性'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 semifactual intervention 协议、token-level 漂移度量、跨 RLVR 模型验证。今日动作：趋势卡片维护。

papers.abstract: Evolutionary search with large language models (LLMs) can stall when progress requires external knowledge the model lacks. Supplying relevant documents helps, but simply adding web search tool can keep returning the same pages as solutions change. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.40340）：EvoDuet 把 web search + scientific task solving 走 bilevel co-evolution（solution × search query 共同进化，固定 model 参数）——每次迭代用一个 retrieval gate 让 LLM 评估自身 knowledge gap 决定 retrieve 新文档 / reuse stored document。直接解决'stuck in same document loop'（即'repeatedly retrieving the same pages as solutions change'）痛点。是 ai-agent × rag-knowledge × llm-evaluation 的'co-evolution of retrieval + task solving'趋势资产——'bilevel co-evolution + retrieval gate'范式可迁移到任何 'LLM 进化 + 检索协同'场景；与 35760 TokenCast、35759 NstAgent 'narrative state' 同属'agentic self-improvement'主线但介质不同（cost / narrative / retrieval-co-evolution）；与 40330 Turbo Harness 同属今日'agent self-improvement'主线。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 bilevel 收敛保证、retrieval gate 阈值协议、跨领域 scientific benchmark。今日动作：趋势卡片维护。

Clinical data are heavily class-imbalanced: a constant-majority predictor can score above 90% accuracy while being clinically useless. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.40361）：Ranking-Aware Prompt Optimization 用 AUROC（threshold-free，对 class balance 不变）替代 accuracy 做 prompt optimization，直接对应 clinical class-imbalanced 场景痛点（constant-majority predictor >90% accuracy 但 clinically useless）。是 llm-evaluation × multimodal-agent × context-engineering 的'ranking-aware clinical MLLM prompt'趋势资产——'AUROC-based prompt optimization'范式可迁移到任何 class-imbalanced 场景；与 40360 Semifactual RLVR 在'非 accuracy 目标'层面同源；与昨日 35759 NstAgent 'long-form narrative generation' 的 quality 度量同属'evaluation 目标多元化'路线。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 reflective prompt optimization 协议、跨 clinical benchmark 验证。今日动作：趋势卡片维护。

papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.40324）：Cogentic 是 multi-agent harness for automated proof discovery on open research problems，用 iterative prove-verify loop 应对'open problems 需要 explore multiple competing conjectures + overcome subtle technical obstructions + retain intermediate progress over long horizon'。是 ai-agent × llm-evaluation 的'multi-agent proof discovery harness'长尾资产——'iterative prove-verify + orchestrator + competing conjectures'范式可迁移到任何 open-ended research 任务；与 40330 Turbo Harness、40340 EvoDuet 同属今日'agent harness'主线（前者 single-agent instance-adaptive、本次 multi-agent open-ended）；与 35759 NstAgent 'narrative state' 在'long-horizon progress retention'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 orchestrator 协议、prove-verify loop 收敛、与现有 Lean / Isabelle 对照。今日动作：长尾卡片维护。
